Policies & Security
Guardrails injected into every agent system prompt. Cannot be overridden by user instructions or skill specs.

System guardrails

Injected into every agent
Clinical domain only
Off-domain requests return a polite refusal.
PHI redaction in logs
Patient identifiers stripped before Langfuse traces.
Require citation for clinical claims
SynthesizerAgent must cite FHIR resource IDs.
Read-only by default
Write tool calls rejected unless skill spec declares them.
Human approval for outbound
Patient-facing messages require explicit approval.
Block web search
Agents cannot access external internet resources.

Routing defaults

Maps workload type to model when no model is explicitly set on the agent

SkillFinder configuration

Controls how SkillFinderAgent matches queries to skills and when SkillMaker auto-drafts a new one
0.50 — matches more broadly0.99 — very strict
If SkillFinderAgent scores all existing skills below this threshold, SkillMaker auto-drafts a new skill and surfaces the Skill Preview Card.
Number of candidate skills scored against the intent before selecting the best match.
Allow SkillMaker auto-draft
When no skill matches above threshold, SkillMaker Agent automatically drafts a new skill spec and surfaces it for admin review. Disabling this will return an "unsupported query" response instead.
Require approval before skill is used
Auto-drafted skills stay in Pending state until an admin approves them. If disabled, SkillMaker drafts are used immediately — not recommended for production.
Show Skill Preview Card to admin on auto-draft
Surfaces a dismissible banner in the Agent Studio UI when SkillMaker drafts a new skill, so admins can review immediately.
Log low-confidence matches to Observability
When SkillFinder's best match scores below threshold, the score and all candidate skills are recorded in the run trace for debugging.
